premise: Butterfly wakes brand new with crumpled wet wings; Mushroom offers her sunny cap to dry them on and Ladybug counts down to the very first flight.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: no ugliness and no teasing, only a new-wing morning and two friends cheering the first flutter.
lesson: New things take a little time and a little cheering.

en-US.title: Butterfly's First Morning
en-US.text: {ladybug:float loop 0.3} Something was happening on the twig. Crick. Crack. A little door opened, and out came {butterfly:fade-in 1.0} Butterfly. Brand new. Wet and crumpled, wings folded up like a tiny paper bag. {butterfly:wobble x2} Hello? said Butterfly, wobbling. Hello! said Ladybug, hurrying over. Oh, you're new! What do I do? asked Butterfly. My wings feel funny. Mushroom's cap was warm in the sun. Sit here, she said softly. Butterfly {butterfly:hop} climbed onto Mushroom's cap and spread their crumpled wings. Just wait, said Mushroom. The sun did the rest. Slowly the wings uncurled. Slowly they dried. Slowly, colours came, {butterfly:tint #FFB347 2s} orange, and gold, and a spot of blue. Ladybug could not sit still. Are they ready? Nearly, said Mushroom. Ladybug counted. Three. Two. One. Butterfly {butterfly:hop} flapped. {butterfly:float 0.9} Up they went, a wobble, a dip, and then, {butterfly:sparkle} flying! Look at me! said Butterfly. {mushroom:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} We're looking, said Mushroom. We're looking.

es-ES.title: La primera mañana de Mariposa
es-ES.text: {ladybug:float loop 0.3} Algo pasaba en la ramita. Cric. Crac. Se abrió una puertecita, y salió {butterfly:fade-in 1.0} Mariposa. Recién nacida. Mojada y arrugada, con las alas plegadas como una bolsita de papel. {butterfly:wobble x2} ¿Hola?, dijo Mariposa, tambaleándose. ¡Hola!, dijo Mariquita, corriendo hacia ella. ¡Ay, eres nueva! ¿Qué hago?, preguntó Mariposa. Las alas me sienten raras. Seta estaba cerca, con el sombrero calentito al sol de la mañana. Siéntate aquí, dijo bajito. Mariposa {butterfly:hop} subió al sombrero de Seta y estiró sus alas arrugadas. Espera, dijo Seta. El sol hizo el resto. Despacio, las alas se desplegaron. Despacio, se secaron. Despacio, llegaron los colores, {butterfly:tint #FFB347 2s} naranja, y dorado, y una mota azul. Mariquita no podía estarse quieta. ¿Ya están? Casi, dijo Seta. Mariquita contó. Tres. Dos. Uno. Mariposa {butterfly:hop} aleteó. {butterfly:float 0.9} Subió, un tambaleo, un bajón, y luego, {butterfly:sparkle} ¡volando! ¡Miradme!, dijo Mariposa. {mushroom:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} Te miramos, dijo Seta. Te miramos.

sound.note: a tiny dry crack of the chrysalis opening
